title: AEGIS Synthetic Borrower Persona
description: A persona template used by Day 5 generation prompts to instantiate synthetic borrowers. See data/synthetic/borrowers/PERSONA_SPEC.md for full spec.

persona_id.description: Zero-padded 3-digit integer followed by vertical and difficulty slug, e.g. '001-services-easy'.

revenue_band.description: Annual revenue band. small=$200K-$750K, medium=$750K-$3M, large=$3M-$10M. See PERSONA_SPEC.md §3.

gross_margin_band.description: Gross margin band. low=<35%, medium=35-60%, high=>60%.

dscr_band.description: Debt service coverage ratio band. strong=>1.50x, adequate=1.20-1.50x, thin=1.00-1.20x, insufficient=<1.00x.

leverage_band.description: Leverage band (total debt / EBITDA). low=<2x, moderate=2-4x, high=>4x.

messiness_traits.description: Set of messiness trait codes from PERSONA_SPEC.md §4. Minimum 2 items required.

primary_discrepancy.description: The single intentional discrepancy Phase 3 reconciliation must detect. See PERSONA_SPEC.md §5.

discrepancy_magnitude.description: Severity of the intentional discrepancy. minor=<10%, moderate=10-25%, material=>25%.

owner_ownership_pct.description: Percentage of the business owned by the principal. See PERSONA_SPEC.md §6.

owner_years_in_industry.description: Years of experience in the vertical.

owner_key_person_risk.description: True if the owner is the sole operational key person.

owner_personal_credit.description: Personal credit profile. strong=720+, adequate=660-719, weak=<660.

owner_personal_liquidity.description: Personal liquidity coverage. high=>6 months, moderate=3-6 months, low=<3 months.

owner_hollow_guarantee_risk.description: True if the personal guarantee would be practically unenforceable.

loan_type.description: Type of loan facility requested. See PERSONA_SPEC.md §7.

loan_purpose.description: Stated purpose of the loan proceeds.

requested_amount_band.description: Loan size band, maps to revenue bands in §3.

business_description.description: 1-2 sentence plain-English description of the business for use in generation prompts.

key_risk_narrative.description: 1-2 sentence plain-English summary of the primary underwriting risk.

discrepancy_description.description: 1 sentence describing the specific inconsistency the Day 5 generation prompt should embed.
